history.summary: Shiv Mandir Chhapara is a local Shiva shrine in Chhapara town, Seoni district, Madhya Pradesh, documented at Hospital - Chhapara Main Road, Chhapara 480884, and mapped with a full-address match at Chhapara 480884. Chhapara is a tehsil headquarters (PIN 480884) hosting several Shiva shrines, so the referent is pinned to the Hospital-Chhapara Main Road listing; neighbours like the Mahakal Temple and Shankar Marhiya on Chhapara Main Road are recorded as alternate candidates, not merged. No founding date, patron or detailed history is published in the consulted sources; it is a neighbourhood-level shrine serving the Chhapara town community.
